note: Ste. Genevieve County parcels are not published as an open queryable service. The assessor's Integrity Web GIS states that access requires a license agreement and fees. The semogis ArcGIS server hosting the city/assessor base data (SteGenCity/SteGenAssessorBaseData) returns 'Token Required' on its /server/ path and HTTP 503 on its /arcgis/ path across repeated attempts. The county public-base service (SteGenevieveCo_PublicBase) has only roads, city limits and county boundary, no parcel layer.
